title: Three Microbial Musketeers of the Seas: Shewanella baltica, Aliivibrio fischeri and Vibrio harveyi, and Their Adaptation to Different Salinity Probed by a Proteomic Approach.
authors: Kloska, Anna; Cech, Grzegorz M; Nowicki, Dariusz; Maciag-Dorszynska, Monika; Bogucka, Aleksandra E; Markert, Stephanie; Becher, Dorte; Potrykus, Katarzyna; Czaplewska, Paulina; Szalewska-Palasz, Agnieszka
one_liner_zh: 该文通过蛋白质组学分析海洋细菌对盐度胁迫的适应，虽涉及DNA结合蛋白积累，但未聚焦TF-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Osmotic changes are common challenges for marine microorganisms. Bacteria have developed numerous ways of dealing with this stress, including reprogramming of global cellular processes. However, specific molecular adaptation mechanisms to osmotic stress have mainly been investigated in terrestrial model bacteria. In this work, we aimed to elucidate the basis of adjustment to prolonged salinity challenges at the proteome level in marine bacteria. The objects of our studies were three representatives of bacteria inhabiting various marine environments, Shewanella baltica, Vibrio harveyi and Aliivibrio fischeri. The proteomic studies were performed with bacteria cultivated in increased and decreased salinity, followed by proteolytic digestion of samples which were then subjected to liquid chromatography with tandem mass spectrometry analysis. We show that bacteria adjust at all levels of their biological processes, from DNA topology through gene expression regulation and proteasome assembly, to transport and cellular metabolism. The finding that many similar adaptation strategies were observed for both low- and high-salinity conditions is particularly striking. The results show that adaptation to salinity challenge involves the accumulation of DNA-binding proteins and increased polyamine uptake. We hypothesize that their function is to coat and protect the nucleoid to counteract adverse changes in DNA topology due to ionic shifts.
abstract_zh: 渗透压变化是海洋微生物面临的常见挑战。细菌已发展出多种应对这种胁迫的方式，包括重编程全局细胞过程。然而，针对渗透胁迫的特异性分子适应机制主要在地球模式细菌中进行了研究。在本工作中，我们旨在阐明海洋细菌在蛋白质组水平上适应长期盐度挑战的基础。我们的研究对象是栖息于不同海洋环境的三种细菌代表：Shewanella baltica、Vibrio harveyi 和 Aliivibrio fischeri。蛋白质组学研究在增加和降低盐度条件下培养的细菌中进行，随后对样品进行蛋白水解消化，再通过液相色谱结合串联质谱分析。我们表明，细菌在其生物过程的所有层面进行调整，从DNA拓扑结构、基因表达调控和蛋白酶体组装，到转运和细胞代谢。特别引人注目的是，在低盐和高盐条件下观察到许多相似的适应策略。结果表明，对盐度挑战的适应涉及DNA结合蛋白的积累和多胺摄取的增加。我们假设其功能是包被并保护核仁，以抵消离子变化引起的DNA拓扑结构不利改变。
